about_the_game:
Customize Your Lucky Cards

In Lucky Card, you can freely customize the winning rules of scratch cards and the possible prizes. Fit more scratch cards into the rule cards with limited space, turning every scratch into a unique adventure filled with strategic variables and surprising feedback!

Break the Boundaries of Reality

The prizes of scratch cards are endowed with diverse "synergy rules". Combined with different rule cards, buffs, panel light effects, color strips, and boss strategies, they open up new paths for you to win big with scratch cards.

  • 4 types of winning rule cards, each with a different winning multiplier

  • Over 200 types of scratch card winning elements, allowing you to create various synergies

  • 5 light effects and 5 color strip variants of scratch cards, which can enhance the basic attributes of scratch cards

  • 20 types of buffs, further boosting the reward values

  • 20 types of boss strategies, helping you take a bold shot at critical moments

Multiple Challenges

Including 12 difficulty adjustments, "leftover game" levels, daily clear challenges, and more.
Use detailed on-screen statistics to analyze your best score-boosting elements, most frequently used scratch cards, and more!

short_description: Lucky Card takes scratch cards as its prototype and integrates roguelite, strategic deck-building, and inventory management gameplay. It creates a unique immersive experience that real-world scratch cards can never replicate.
